coverage.summary: Applies to rental residential real property generally. The section states no unit-count, building-age, construction-date or owner-occupancy limits or exemptions.

evidence.quoted_span: A licensed broker or salesperson may solely contract with a prospective tenant to find rental residential real property for a tenant

result.notes: Removed other_conditions ('Applies only where a broker or salesperson is engaged for a fee'). Engaging a broker for a fee is the transaction the rule regulates, not a feature of the building, unit or owner. It also describes conduct by the parties, including the landlord. The summary is rewritten for the same reason. G.L. c. 112, § 87DDD½ (D057) contains no unit-count, construction-date, building-age, owner-occupancy or landlord-size conditions, so those fields stay null. No local-preemption or yields-to-local language appears in the section. The broker regulations at 254 CMR 7 are mentioned only in secondary source DX13 and do not bear on coverage.
